name: Sales Push Notification
author: hamzakarkich

sections.description:
Increase Conversions with Social Proof

Sales Push Notification displays recent purchase notifications on your WooCommerce store to leverage social proof and create a sense of urgency. When visitors see others making purchases, they’re more likely to convert.

Key Features

  • Real-Time WooCommerce Integration – Show actual purchases from your store
  • Fully Customizable Appearance – Match your store’s branding with custom colors and styles
  • Mobile-Friendly Design – Responsive notifications that look great on all devices
  • Position Control – Choose where notifications appear on your site
  • Timing Controls – Set display duration, frequency, and initial delay
  • Privacy-Focused – Only shows customer’s first name and city for privacy protection
  • Performance Optimized – Lightweight code that won’t slow down your site
  • Review Generator – Create authentic product reviews with advanced customization

Pro Version Features

  • Remove “by Hamza” Watermark – Get a clean, professional look without the attribution
  • Dummy Notifications – Create custom notifications for new stores with low sales volume
  • Position Control – Choose from 4 positions: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right
  • Border Radius Customization – Adjust the roundness of notification corners to match your design
  • Verified Badge Color Customization – Change the color of verification badges on notifications
  • Real Order Verified Color Customization – Highlight real orders with a distinctive verification color
  • Priority Support – Get faster responses to your questions and issues

License Management

The Pro version uses a simple licensing system:

  • One-time purchase for lifetime updates
  • License key activates on a single domain
  • Easy activation/deactivation through the admin panel
  • Automatic license verification ensures your features stay active

Perfect For

  • E-commerce stores looking to increase conversion rates
  • New stores wanting to build credibility
  • Established stores showcasing their popularity
  • Any WooCommerce site wanting to create urgency and FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out)

Easy Setup

Install the plugin, activate it, and it automatically starts displaying your recent WooCommerce orders as attractive notifications. Customize colors, timing, and appearance from the simple settings panel.

Developer-Friendly

Clean, well-documented code makes it easy to customize and extend. Built with WordPress best practices and optimized for performance.

Support

Need help? Have questions? Visit our support forum or check out the documentation.

WooCommerce Compatibility

  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Works with both traditional and modern WooCommerce data storage methods
  • Optimized for the latest WooCommerce features

License Management

How does the licensing system work?

The Pro version uses a license key system that connects to our license server to verify your purchase. Your license key activates on a single domain and provides access to all Pro features.

Can I use my license on multiple sites?

Each license key is valid for one domain. If you need to use the Pro version on multiple sites, you’ll need to purchase additional licenses.

How do I activate my license?

After purchasing, you’ll receive a license key. Go to Settings > Sales Push > License tab, enter your key, and click “Activate License”.

What happens if my license expires?

The plugin will continue to work, but you’ll lose access to Pro features until you renew your license.

How do I deactivate my license?

If you need to move your license to another site, go to Settings > Sales Push > License tab and click “Deactivate License”. You can then activate it on another domain.

Privacy Policy

Sales Push Notification uses WooCommerce order data to display recent purchases on your site. The plugin only displays the customer’s first name and city (not full address) to protect their privacy. No customer data is sent to external servers or third parties.

The Review Generator feature creates reviews locally in your WordPress database and does not send any data to external services.

External Services

This plugin connects to Gumroad’s API (api.gumroad.com) for license verification of the Pro version. The following data is sent when verifying licenses:

  • License key
  • Product ID
  • Domain name (for license activation)

This service is used only when activating/verifying Pro licenses and is not required for the free version of the plugin.

Gumroad Terms of Service: https://gumroad.com/terms
Gumroad Privacy Policy: https://gumroad.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sales-push-notification folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Sales Push to configure the plugin
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated for real order notifications
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce is required for real order notifications. Without WooCommerce, the plugin will not function properly.

Will this slow down my website?

No, Sales Push Notification is designed to be lightweight and optimized for performance. It loads resources only when needed and uses efficient code practices.

Is customer data protected?

Yes, we take privacy seriously. The plugin only displays the customer’s first name and city (not full address) to protect their privacy.

Can I customize the appearance of notifications?

Yes, you can customize the appearance of your notifications. The free version allows basic color customization, while the Pro version offers additional options like border radius, notification position, and verified badge color customization.

How do I disable notifications on mobile devices?

In the plugin settings under the General tab, simply check the “Disable on Mobile” option.

Can I show notifications for specific products only?

Yes, in the Pro version you can select specific products to feature in dummy notifications.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, Sales Push Notification is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) feature. You can enable this feature in WooCommerce without any compatibility issues.

What happens if I deactivate the Pro license?

When you deactivate your Pro license, the plugin will revert to the free version functionality. Pro features like custom positions, border radius customization, and dummy notifications will no longer be available.

Is there a trial version of Pro?

We don’t currently offer a trial version, but we do offer a 30-day money-back guarantee if you’re not satisfied with the Pro features.

How often does the plugin verify my license?

The plugin verifies your license once per day to ensure it’s still valid. This is a lightweight check that doesn’t impact your site’s performance.

What data is sent to the license server?

When verifying your license, the plugin sends your license key, product ID, and domain name to our license server. No personal data or site content is collected.

What color customization options are available in the Pro version?

The Pro version offers several advanced color customization options, including:
* Verified Badge Color – Change the color of the verification badge on regular notifications
* Real Order Verified Color – Set a distinct color for verification badges on real order notifications
* Border Radius – Adjust the roundness of notification corners
* Multiple Position Options – Place notifications in any corner of the screen

These options allow you to perfectly match the notifications to your site’s design.

How does the Review Generator work?

The Review Generator allows you to create authentic WooCommerce product reviews with advanced customization features including bulk creation, custom date ranges, rating controls, and the ability to target specific products or categories.
